name: Yodono Kenta
source:
A manager at an entertainment agency.
In his youth, he spent his days fighting, and even made his debut as a fighter, touting himself as the strongest fighter.
He and Sakuma have a relationship like that of a senior and junior, and even serves as Sakuma's bodyguard when he goes out.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/torikonotsubasa/]official site[/url]]
